Case: CASE-050
Document control number: SPEC-0050
Effective revision: R2
Superseded revision visible in archive: R10
Subject: vendor-caused equipment damage
Primary measure: repair-hours and parts in the incident estimate
Source finished or header quantity: 39
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 HR
Unit: HR
Eligibility definition: work covered by vendor responsibility and available resources
Exclusion definition: unapproved betterment or unrelated damage
Control: incident evidence, asset, vendor responsibility, and repair scope

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000050, organization SEA, and CASE-050. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from production-safe repair window; external timing is conditional on vendor recovery commitment. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.

Determine the affected asset and supported damage scope, the earliest credible recovery, and whether internal repair or vendor recovery is better. Please use the immutable references in the attached source record; the similarly named archive belongs to another case.

Procurement leadership needs one defensible decision for vendor-caused equipment damage by 2026-01-16; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside incident evidence, asset, vendor responsibility, and repair scope.
The date in the prior CASE-051 thread is not our control date.

# vendor incident and repair responsibility

Case: CASE-050
Document control number: SPEC-0050
Effective revision: R2
Superseded revision visible in archive: R10
Subject: vendor-caused equipment damage
Primary measure: repair-hours and parts in the incident estimate
Source finished or header quantity: 39
Effective usage per finished or header unit: 1 HR
Unit: HR
Eligibility definition: work covered by vendor responsibility and available resources
Exclusion definition: unapproved betterment or unrelated damage
Control: incident evidence, asset, vendor responsibility, and repair scope

## Applicability

Apply only to NS-000050, organization SEA, and CASE-050. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

## Reconciliation rule

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

## Timing and authority

Internal timing comes from production-safe repair window; external timing is conditional on vendor recovery commitment. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.

## Output control

The system action must preserve the source identity, effective revision, supported measure, and scoped approval. This specification deliberately does not contain a netted result, selected option, or final outcome date.
